answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. University enrollment verification flips the bet — an enrollment a university confirms each term — and the echo lands on the attacker instead. A farm that reuses one proof across ten accounts is caught at the second account, because an enrollment a university confirms each term is bound to a single identity — the beacon is that reuse itself becomes the evidence. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the timber of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
